result:
The rename is live: `billingUrl` is now `billingEndpoint` with the same value. PR #1 on the monorepo was merged, CI is green, and CD succeeded on `main`.

- **What changed:** the shared configuration in `libs/shared-contracts` and its three users, `core-shell`, `sub-route-billing` and `sub-route-reports`. I included reports because it also read the old name and the acceptance criteria cover any app that used it. No `billingUrl` references remain, and all three apps built locally.
- **No version bump or dependency update:** `shared-contracts` lives in the monorepo and is inlined into each app at build time, so there was no release to publish or adopt. That made sub-tasks 2 and 3's "adopt the new release" a no-op, and one PR covered sub-tasks 1–3.
- **Platform kit (sub-task 4):** I made no change and opened no PR. `libs-platform-kit` never referenced `billingUrl` or depended on `shared-contracts`, so there was nothing to rename or adopt.

I recorded these assumptions in `st done`.
